description_en: Enables session sharing and retrieves the sharing link
description_zh: 开启会话分享并获取链接
name: EnableConversationShare

parameters.help_en:
The sharing scope. Valid values:
PUBLIC: accessible to all users
SPECIFIED: accessible to specified users or user groups
parameters.help_zh: 分享范围：PUBLIC为全部可访问，SPECIFIED为指定用户或用户组
parameters.name: share_access_type

parameters.help_en: The list of platform user IDs for the specified scope. When shareAccessType is set to SPECIFIED, at least one of this list or the user group list must not be empty
parameters.help_zh: 指定范围的平台用户ID列表；shareAccessType为SPECIFIED时与用户组列表至少一项非空
parameters.name: share_user_ids

parameters.help_en: The list of user group IDs for the specified scope. When shareAccessType is set to SPECIFIED, at least one of this list or the user list must not be empty
parameters.help_zh: 指定范围的用户组ID列表；shareAccessType为SPECIFIED时与用户列表至少一项非空
parameters.name: share_user_group_ids

parameters.help_en: The unique identifier of the function session
parameters.name: session_id

code.description_en: The result code. A value of SUCCESS indicates success. For failures, the corresponding error type is returned, such as ERR_BAD_REQUEST, ERR_VALIDATION_FAILED, or ERR_INTERNAL_SERVER_ERROR
code.description_zh: SUCCESS 为成功，失败情况返回对应错误类型，比如 ERR_BAD_REQUEST ERR_VALIDATION_FAILED ERR_INTERNAL_SERVER_ERROR
code.title_en: SUCCESS 为成功，失败情况返回对应错误类型，比如 ERR_BAD_REQUEST ERR_VALIDATION_FAILED ERR_INTERNAL_SERVER_ERROR
code.title_zh: SUCCESS 为成功，失败情况返回对应错误类型，比如 ERR_BAD_REQUEST ERR_VALIDATION_FAILED ERR_INTERNAL_SERVER_ERROR

sessionId.description_en: The ID of the source single-chat session

shareAccessType.description_en: The current sharing scope. Valid values: PUBLIC and SPECIFIED

shareEnabledAt.description_en: The time when sharing was most recently enabled, in ISO 8601 format

sharePath.description_en: The relative path for in-site sharing. This value is empty when sharing is disabled
sharePath.description_zh: 站内分享相对路径；关闭时为空

shareToken.description_en: The sharing token. This token is present when sharing is enabled and can be used to access the public sharing preview API operation
shareToken.description_zh: 分享 token（开启分享时存在），凭此可访问公开分享预览接口
shareToken.title_en: 分享 token（开启分享时存在），凭此可访问公开分享预览接口
shareToken.title_zh: 分享 token（开启分享时存在），凭此可访问公开分享预览接口

shareUrl.description_en: The absolute URL of the current sharing link. This value is empty when sharing is disabled
shareUrl.description_zh: 当前分享绝对链接；关闭时为空

shareUserGroupIds.description_en: The list of currently specified user group IDs

items.description_en: The currently specified user group ID

shareUserIds.description_en: The list of currently specified user IDs

items.description_en: The currently specified platform user ID
